name: PR detail: severity counters pop up findings on hover and filter on click
description: On PR #482 → Agent runs, the 'Findings by severity' bar counts the seeded review (1 CRITICAL, 1 WARNING, 0 SUGGESTION — see server/src/db/seed.ts). Hovering '1 CRITICAL' opens the findings popup with the seeded CRITICAL finding; clicking it sets ?sev=critical and leaves only CRITICAL finding cards, so the WARNING one ('N+1 query in user list endpoint') is gone. 'Clear filter' brings it back. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Spec: docs/specs/findings-severity-counters.md.
